in_marathi.name: Eeshita
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of wealth and prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Eeshita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Eeshita is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Eesha', which means 'goddess of wealth and prosperity'. This name is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and is often given to girls to bestow upon them the blessings of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune.
